Definition: copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver)
BiblicalUsage: Cymbals of brass sound when David brings up the ark with singing and with all his might, and the sixty great cities of Argob are shut with walls and bars of brass.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe brass rings in both worship and war: the cymbals before the ark and the bars on the gates of Argob are the same metal, and God rules both the song and the city.
